name: atlanai-mods
description: Claude Code mod for the Atlan registry: registry reads run without a prompt, writes ask first, archive and move show what depends on the artifact, temporary gateway errors tell Claude how to retry, Atlan calls read as one line in the transcript, a pane lists what the session touched, a band follows a skill publish, /atlan skills picks a skill to load, and the status line reports a broken or degraded Atlan connection.

confirm_writes.title: Ask before registry writes
confirm_writes.description: Ask before Claude creates or changes anything in Atlan. Archive, approve and move always ask.
